## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
This review found no defects in the changed code. The new `--exclude` flag follows the project's CLI-flag and logging rules, and the added tests check single and repeated patterns at both the `collect` level and the archive level.

## Changes
This pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag to `cli/main.py`. Each pattern is matched against file basenames through a new `is_excluded` helper, and matching files are left out of `collect`. It also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md`, adds five tests to `tests/test_main.py` and adds a one-line fixture, `tests/fixtures/hostile-review.txt`.
